result.summary: Verified against live db_test: information_schema.table_constraints/constraint_column_usage FK query found zero dependents on the public copy of any of the 14 tables. Row-count inspection: 13 tables' public copies are all empty (0 rows) confirming PER_TENANT (canonical=tenant_default); tenant_artifact_activations has 8 live rows in public vs 0 in tenant_default confirming GLOBAL_REGISTRY (canonical=public), consistent with src/config/loader.zig's tenant_id-filtered query shape (same as service_catalog). Grepped all 10 source migrations (004, 007, 008, 010, 012, 019, 026, 058, 093, 095) -- none carry a scope header. 13 of 14 names already appear in docs/issue-reports/ISS-0185-diagnosis.yaml's classification tables (12 already in GBL-135's own drop array); only lua_script_execution_audit (migration 095, post-dates ISS-0185) is genuinely new -- classified PER_TENANT by analogy (keyed by instance_id, no tenant_id column, same shape as instance_definition_snapshots/instance_waits).
